objective: Read function bytes and relocations from ELF64 little-endian x86-64 relocatable objects using only Rust std.

interface.FunctionImage: pub name: String, pub address: u64, pub bytes: Vec<u8>, pub relocations: Vec<Relocation>
interface.Relocation: pub offset: u64 (relative to function start), pub kind: u32, pub symbol: Option<String>
interface.function: pub fn read_function(object: &[u8], symbol: &str) -> Result<FunctionImage, ElfError>

constraints: ET_REL initially, reject other formats explicitly
checked range and offset arithmetic, no panic on malformed input
find STT_FUNC named symbol in SHT_SYMTAB; honor symbol size
collect SHT_RELA/SHT_REL relocations whose sites overlap the selected function
do not resolve or ignore relocations; parent rejects them before lifting
standard library only; no objdump/objcopy or external parser in implementation
only parent integrates patch into shared workspace
